title: hieracium calvifolium
intro: Hieracium calvifolium, commonly known as bare-stemmed hawk's-beard, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the dandelion family. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating digestive issues, lowering blood pressure, and possessing anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium calvifolium include its ability to stimulate digestion, calm the nervous system, and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium calvifolium include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
